items.q: he explained to us, because of this record session with Dave Capp

ctx.x: Because -- he explained to us, because of this record session with Dave Capp and Dave Capp kept saying, 'Guys, I can't sell this stuff.' And he had these beautiful arrangements, and he kept saying, 'I can't sell it.' And they said, 'Do you know a blues?' Jay says, 'Yeah.'
